pain_point: Medical residents and fellows rotate across hospitals monthly and must manually reconstruct their case logs, procedure counts, and competency milestones for each rotation — a tedious, error-prone process that often gets neglected until deadline panic
target_user: Medical residents and fellows (all specialties) who rotate through multiple clinical sites and must track case logs for ACGME accreditation
visual_style: Medical Chart Clipboard — warm clinical paper stock with ruled lines, stamped patient-chart headers, handwritten-style Caveat labels for personal notes, IBM Plex Mono for data values, crisp teal-and-white clinical accents. Think: a well-organized resident's clipboard, not a hospital EHR.
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
